- Player at row 36 (DOWN)
- Path at rows 38-39, fully extended to col 46
- Left strip: G at 16-19, 22-25, 28-31, 34-35
After ACTION7:
- Player at row 30 (UP)
- Path at row 32, fully extended to col 46
- Left strip: G at 16-19, 22-25, 28-29, 36-37
So ACTION7:
1. Moves player from DOWN to UP
2. Path stays extended (but moves to the new height)
3. Left strip pattern changes
Then when I pressed DOWN:
- Player moved to row 36
- Path disappeared!
This is weird. The path should have reappeared at row 38-39. Unless... ACTION7 "consumed" the path, and it only exists temporarily after ACTION7?
